results.name: Wooden Retail Display Stand
results.description:
Wooden Retail Display Stand measuring 1640mm in height, 2440mm in width, and 
350 & 500mm in depth. This retail display shelving unit is constructed entirely from 
plywood, making it an excellent choice for showcasing small items near a checkout 
area, such as souvenirs, jewelry, medium-sized products, and more.

The unit is equipped with two internal fixed shelves positioned 300mm above the 
desk cabinet. The space above is divided with side panels and a longitudinal panel, 
providing the necessary support to prevent shelf bending.
